name: @workspace-skills/onboarding
//peerDependencies: This skill's components are rendered inside a panel's realm, which already holds React and the Radix theme. Declared as peers, they resolve to those live instances instead of being bundled again -- a second React means the host's hooks and the guest's are different hooks, and a second Theme means the guest renders outside the host's context.
//devDependencies: @testing-library/react renders through @testing-library/dom and declares it as a peer rather than depending on it, so it has to be named here: the build installs what manifests declare and never adds a package on the registry's behalf.
